verdict.rationale: Sandboxed execution is a fair question for an agentic coding assistant like Kimi Code, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows the agent reading code, editing files and running commands directly in a local project folder or terminal. Nothing documents a sandbox, an isolated environment, a dry-run mode or any separation from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
